extracted.intended_audience: researchers, preprint curators, and potential Sciety users interested in preprint discovery and evaluated preprints
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance about discovering, curating, and evaluating preprints using the Sciety platform, emphasising passive discovery, community-curated expert commentary, and trust indicators for preprints. Also includes event accessibility and conduct expectations for participants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Value of evaluated preprints
rubrics_metrics.description: For many researchers the steady growth in preprint adoption represents a net good for academic publishing, helping to change the culture of scientific discourse through open discussion, transparency, and constructive criticism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluated preprints are presented as valuable because they enable open discussion, transparency and constructive criticism; they are increasingly cited, accepted in job applications, and recognised by funders — implying that preprints that have been evaluated/commented on carry greater credibility and utility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Need for standardised trust indicators around preprints
rubrics_metrics.description: The lack of standardised trust indicators around preprints can harbour distrust from the community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work on or adopt standardised trust indicators (metadata, evaluations, badges, expert commentary) to reduce distrust and help researchers assess preprint reliability quickly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Efficient (passive) research discovery
rubrics_metrics.description: Sciety enables researchers to efficiently discover, openly curate and evaluate relevant preprints, and to aid passive research discovery to save time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design discovery workflows (or use tools) that surface relevant evaluated preprints without active searching — e.g., curated feeds, alerts, or platform features that prioritise community-evaluated items — to help researchers 'keep on top' of literature without excessive time cost.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community-curated expert commentary
rubrics_metrics.description: Sciety demonstrates how discovery of the latest research findings can be accompanied by expert commentary curated by the community — all in one place.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritise inclusion of expert commentary and community curation as part of preprint presentation; such commentary serves as an interpretive trust signal and aids users in quickly understanding significance, limitations, and context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Event accessibility and conduct requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: The webinar will have closed captions provided by Zoom; attendees can request further accessibility support. Sciety is committed to providing a safe and welcoming experience and expects attendees to familiarise themselves with and abide by eLife’s Code of Conduct.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When organising or attending events about preprints or peer review, ensure accessibility (provide captions, respond to accessibility requests) and enforce codes of conduct to maintain a welcoming environment.
